backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing a grocery store with product management, shopping cart, orders, mobile recharge, and role-based access control (admin/user permissions). Includes blob storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting PWA implementation including manifest, service worker, mobile optimizations, and HTML meta tags with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the grocery store PWA application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color palette with warm earthy tones for light and dark modes, plus custom CSS properties for the design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags for mobile app capabilities, viewport configuration, theme color, and links to manifest and app icons.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons (192x192, 512x512, 180x180), standalone display mode, portrait orientation, and earthy theme colors for installable mobile app.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle management for offline functionality.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, and admin pages wrapped in shared layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization wrapper component that checks user authentication and admin permissions, displaying appropriate error alerts or loading states before rendering protected admin content.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, and image upload. Handles file upload with progress tracking and uses ExternalBlob for image storage.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with delete functionality. Shows product images, names, categories, prices, and includes a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to 9142876085 when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer component displaying cart items with quantities, subtotal, and checkout/clear cart actions. Includes swipe-to-close gesture support for mobile.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable category filter with buttons to select different product categories. Highlights the currently selected category.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information: free within 1km, ₹20 per km beyond that.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with store information, contact details (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and attribution to caffeine.ai. Displays in a three-column grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with store logo, navigation links, cart button with item count badge, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity. Includes integrated CartDrawer.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and CallUsButton with a gradient background and centers content in a container.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: React component for mobile recharge form with operator selection, mobile number input, and amount entry. Validates inputs and submits recharge orders via backend actor.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment QR code card with amount and UPI payment instructions. Shows static QR image and contact information for payment confirmation.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, category, price, and add-to-cart button. Handles cart mutations with authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Grid layout for products with category filtering. Fetches all products, displays loading skeletons, and renders filtered ProductCard components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY AuthClient. Manages login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, and recharge orders. Wraps actor calls with query/mutation logic and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using warm, earthy tones for grocery store theme. Includes dark mode support and mobile touch-friendly utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying order statistics (total orders, recharge orders, revenue) and tabs for managing products, viewing orders, and recharge orders. Protected by AdminGuard component.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page that collects customer delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculates total price including delivery fees, and places orders. Validates user authentication and cart contents before proceeding.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid with browsing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing success message, order ID, payment QR code, and next steps for completing payment and delivery. Retrieves order total from sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location with Google Maps embed, delivery policy, store hours, and available services for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for an e-commerce grocery store app with Google sign-in, phone verification, cart, ordering, admin panel, mobile recharge, and distance-based delivery fees. Contains architectural notes, existing features, requirements, and file manifests for the 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point' storefront.
